shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "node --version && npm --version && git log --oneline -5 && git ls-tree -r HEAD --name-only | sed -n '1,120p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,90p' package-lock.json && git diff --stat && git diff --check && npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm test && npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm test && npm run build && git diff --check && (PORT=4173 node server.js > /tmp/shelf-server.log 2>&1 & server_pid=$!; trap '"'kill \""'$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true'"' EXIT; for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:4173/api/books >/tmp/shelf-books.json && break; sleep 0.2; done; curl -fsS -o /tmp/shelf-detail.html -w '%{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:4173/books/the-left-hand-of-darkness; node -e \"const fs=require('node:fs'); const books=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/shelf-books.json')); console.log(books.length, books.map(b=>b.status).join(',')); const page=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/shelf-detail.html','utf8'); console.log(page.includes('id=\\\"app\\\"') ? 'app shell ok' : 'app shell missing')\" )"
